name: Smart Cities Mission

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A mission to develop selected cities across India by providing core infrastructure, a clean and sustainable environment, and quality of life to citizens through smart solutions.
objectives: Provide core urban infrastructure and services
Promote sustainable and inclusive urban development
Leverage technology for better city management

benefits.title: Urban Infrastructure Development
benefits.description: Investment in water supply, sanitation, mobility, e-governance and area-based development

benefits.title: Integrated Command Centres
benefits.description: City-level command and control centres for real-time monitoring

otherCriteria: Applicable at the city/urban local body level, not individual citizens

customQuestions.question: Do you live, work, study or operate a business in a city covered under the Smart Cities Mission?
Is your city one of the 100 cities selected under the Smart Cities Mission?
Are you seeking a city-level service or facility provided through a Smart Cities Mission project?
Does your requirement relate to areas such as transport, water supply, sanitation, waste management, energy, ICT, public safety or other urban services covered by the city's Smart City projects?
If you are using a Smart City digital service/app, are you located within the service area covered by that particular project?
Is the service/project you are seeking currently operational in your city?
If the benefit is restricted to a particular Area-Based Development (ABD) area, do you live/work/study within that designated area?
If you are participating as a citizen in a Smart City initiative, are you willing to provide the required citizen information/feedback?

applicationProcess.description: Selected cities formed a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)
SPV implements area-based development and pan-city smart solutions
Projects monitored via Integrated Command and Control Centres

faqs.question: How many cities are covered?
faqs.answer: 100 cities were selected under the mission in phases.

faqs.question: Who implements Smart Cities projects?
faqs.answer: A Special Purpose Vehicle set up for each selected city.

name: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation 2.0 (AMRUT 2.0)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A mission to make all cities 'water secure' by providing functional water tap connections, sewerage/septage management, and rejuvenation of water bodies in urban areas.
objectives: Provide universal coverage of water supply in urban areas
Ensure sewerage and septage management in cities
Rejuvenate urban water bodies and promote sustainable water use

benefits.title: Water Supply Infrastructure
benefits.description: Development of piped water supply and sewerage/septage systems in cities

benefits.title: Water Body Rejuvenation
benefits.description: Restoration of urban lakes, ponds and other water bodies

otherCriteria: Applicable at the urban local body level

customQuestions.question: Do you live in an urban area covered under AMRUT 2.0?
Is your city/urban local body included in the AMRUT 2.0 coverage/approved project framework?
Are you seeking a service related to water supply, sewerage/septage, water-body rejuvenation or parks/green spaces?
Are you a resident/household that requires a functional tap-water connection under an applicable city project?
Is your household located within the service/project area covered by the relevant AMRUT 2.0 project?
If you are seeking a water/sewerage connection, is your property located within the area served by the relevant urban local body/project?
If you are participating in an AMRUT Mitra/community initiative, do you meet the specific requirements of that initiative?
If you are applying as an urban local body/implementing agency, are you covered by the applicable AMRUT 2.0 institutional framework?

applicationProcess.description: States/UTs prepare State Water Action Plan

faqs.question: What is the objective of AMRUT 2.0?
faqs.answer: Making all statutory towns water secure through universal water supply coverage.

faqs.question: Is AMRUT 2.0 different from AMRUT?
faqs.answer: It is the second, expanded phase focused on universal water coverage.

name: Bharatmala Pariyojana

ministry.name: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
ministry.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

overview: An umbrella road and highway infrastructure programme focused on optimising the efficiency of road traffic movement across the country through economic corridors, feeder routes and expressways.
objectives: Improve last-mile connectivity to ports and border areas

benefits.title: Highway Infrastructure
benefits.description: Construction of national highways, economic corridors and expressways to improve connectivity

otherCriteria: Nationwide infrastructure programme; not an individual-beneficiary scheme

customQuestions.question: Are you a resident, traveller, transporter, business or other road user who may use a highway developed under Bharatmala?
Is the road/highway you are concerned about part of an approved Bharatmala Pariyojana project?
Is your location connected to an Economic Corridor, Inter-Corridor, Feeder Route, National Corridor, Expressway or other Bharatmala component?
Are you seeking information/service related to a Bharatmala highway project, construction, connectivity or road development?
If you are a landowner/affected person, is your property located within the notified/project area of a Bharatmala road project?
If you are seeking compensation or rehabilitation-related assistance, are you an eligible affected person under the applicable land-acquisition/project rules?
If you are a contractor/concessionaire/project agency, are you participating in an officially tendered Bharatmala project?
Is the particular Bharatmala project currently under implementation/operation or otherwise active?

faqs.question: What is Bharatmala Pariyojana?
faqs.answer: A comprehensive highway development programme covering economic corridors, feeder routes and expressways.

faqs.question: Who executes the projects?
faqs.answer: National Highways Authority of India and state agencies.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
overview: A scheme to provide all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations, improving access to markets, healthcare and education in rural India.
objectives: Provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations
Improve rural connectivity for socio-economic development
Upgrade and maintain existing rural roads

benefits.title: Road Connectivity
benefits.description: Construction of all-weather roads connecting eligible rural habitations to the road network

otherCriteria: Unconnected rural habitations meeting the population/connectivity criteria under the scheme

customQuestions.question: Do you live in a rural habitation/village?
Is your habitation currently unconnected by an all-weather road?
Is the habitation included in the eligible/core rural road network under PMGSY?
Does the habitation meet the applicable population eligibility criteria under the current PMGSY phase?
Is the proposed road intended to provide basic access to a nearby market centre/Rural Business Hub or essential social and economic services?
If the habitation already has an all-weather road, are you seeking upgradation of an eligible existing rural road rather than new connectivity?
Is the proposed road included in the State's approved PMGSY proposal/road plan?
If you are applying as an affected landowner/other stakeholder, is your property or interest within the area of an approved PMGSY road project?

applicationProcess.description: State prepares District Rural Roads Plan
Roads constructed through state implementing agencies

faqs.question: Which habitations are covered?
faqs.answer: Unconnected rural habitations meeting the prescribed population thresholds.

name: Sagarmala Programme

ministry.name: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
ministry.department: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

overview: A flagship programme for port-led development aimed at modernising India's ports, enhancing port connectivity, and promoting coastal community development.
objectives: Modernise ports and reduce logistics costs
Improve port connectivity through rail, road and inland waterways
Promote coastal economic zones and community development

benefits.title: Port Infrastructure Development
benefits.description: Modernisation and capacity augmentation of major and non-major ports

benefits.title: Coastal Community Development
benefits.description: Skill development and livelihood programmes for coastal communities

otherCriteria: Nationwide infrastructure programme; coastal community components benefit local populations

customQuestions.question: Are you a coastal resident/community member who may be covered by a Sagarmala coastal-community development project?
Is your location within the coastal/port area covered by a Sagarmala project?
Are you seeking support related to skill development, livelihood or employment opportunities under a Sagarmala coastal-community initiative?
Are you involved in or seeking opportunities related to fishing, fisheries infrastructure or a fishing harbour project covered under Sagarmala?
Are you a port, State Government, State Maritime Board, Central Government ministry/agency or other eligible project implementing entity proposing a Sagarmala project?
Is the proposed project related to port modernization, port connectivity, port-led industrialization or coastal-community development?
Does the proposed infrastructure project have the required DPR/TEFR and financial/project appraisal documentation?
Is the project proposed to be implemented through an eligible SPV/implementing agency where required?
If seeking Sagarmala funding, does the project satisfy the applicable Sagarmala Funding Guidelines?

applicationProcess.description: Project identification under national perspective plan
Implementation by port authorities/state maritime boards

faqs.question: What does Sagarmala cover?
faqs.answer: Port modernisation, port connectivity, port-led industrialisation and coastal community development.

faqs.question: Which ministry runs Sagarmala?
faqs.answer: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.
